nodes.title: 1. schedule — no source wired, so chunks are just lengths
CHUNKING
widgets_values:
CHUNKED V2V FACE SWAP

Everything above the chunk layer is a WHOLE-CLIP pass and must stay that
way: SAM3 tracking, mask stabilise, grow/blur, H3 Match Source, and the
static H3 Subject Crop. The crop box has to be one box for the whole
take, or the subject moves inside the frame at every chunk boundary.

THE LOOP runs between the crop and the uncrop:

  H3 Chunk Plan reads crop_video and finds the shot boundaries itself
  (chunk_mode `scene`, threshold 0.12). For a swap that is the right
  mode -- the source already has the cuts in it, so there is no reason
  to guess where they are.

  H3 Chunk Open slices FOUR streams on the same boundaries: the cropped
  video, its mask, the audio, and the depth pass on `extra_images`. The
  depth has to be sliced too, or every chunk gets the whole clip's depth
  as its reference video and the motion guide points somewhere else.

  H3 Chunk Context carries continuity IN PIXELS. It writes the previous
  chunk's tail over this chunk's opening frames and blanks the mask
  there, so H3 Mask Inpaint reproduces those frames rather than swapping
  them again. It has to happen here, upstream of the inpaint, because
  the inpaint is what builds the masked latent.

  It already gates on `pin`, which the plan sets to 0 at the first chunk
  of every shot. So the carry stops at a cut with no second setting.

  H3 Chunk Close joins the picture AND the audio, sample-exact, on the
  same boundaries. The video combine nodes take their audio from Close,
  not from the audio decode -- the decode only ever holds the LAST
  chunk.

CHUNK SIZE 90 frames, CONTEXT 22. 90 is a legal run (17*5+5) and divides
by 3, so it lands on both the 24fps video clock and the 40Hz audio one.
22 frames of overlap are generated twice, dropped at the join, and 22 of
them are held.

frame_load_cap on the video loader is still 39, which is one chunk and
exercises none of this. Raise it to run a real take.
